user.title: Lemur Home Dashboard
user.description: Adds the ready-made home dashboard. With "Create the dashboard" on, the dashboard is created for you and shows up in the sidebar after you reload the page once. Edit it from "Lemur Home Dashboard" in the sidebar. (To create it yourself instead: a new dashboard with `strategy: type: custom:lemur-home-dashboard` in its raw configuration.)

feed.name: Feed
feed.description: Records a pet as fed (same as the feeding card).

control.name: Control with backup
control.description: Turns a light on, off or toggles it. If the light has a backup twin set in the admin panel and does not answer in a few seconds, the same command is sent to the twin.
